meta.name: Soft Graphite Minimal — Devashish Juyal portfolio
meta.description: Neumorphic surfaces layered with frosted glass, in a near-monochrome graphite palette. Extracted from a described style (no image reference), so no measured palette; generated with the design-dna skill (Phase 2 from description, Phase 3 generate).
source_references: User brief 2026-11-04: neumorphism + glass hybrid, light/dark toggle, minimalistic palette, recruiter-first, agent-graph hero console
Revision 2026-11-04: user asked for super minimalistic; removed hero console, metrics, chips, case studies, orbs

color.palette_type: monochromatic with a single functional signal color

primary.role: ink: headings, primary button fill, active states

accent.role: signal only: 'open to work' dot, live pulses in the agent console, success copy feedback. Never decorative.

neutral.usage: Light theme: #E6E9EE is the clay surface, #FFFFFF / #C3C9D3 are the neumorphic highlight / shade, #23262D is foreground. Dark theme inverts: #1E2126 surface, #272B31 highlight, #15171B shade, #E8EAED foreground.

surface.card: #E6E9EE (extruded by shadow, same hue as background)
surface.elevated: rgba(255,255,255,0.45) frosted glass over drifting graphite orbs

color.contrast_strategy: Neumorphism blends surfaces, so legibility comes from ink-on-clay text contrast (>= 9:1) rather than surface contrast. Interactive elements get an additional 1px hairline so they read without shadows (WCAG non-text 3:1).

typography.pairing_logic: Tight grotesk for headings, neutral grotesk for reading, mono for metadata, dates, and console output.

layout.alignment: left-aligned, list rows with right-aligned mono dates

shape.borders: 1px hairline rgba(255,255,255,0.6) top-left on glass; 1px rgba(35,38,45,0.06) on controls

elevation.approach: dual-shadow neumorphism (light top-left, shade bottom-right) for clay; backdrop blur for glass

motion.philosophy: tactile: elements press in on click, rise slightly on hover; nothing bounces

components.button_style: Clay pills (low extrusion) that press to inset on :active; 44px round icon buttons.
components.card_style: No cards. Content sits in flat rows; linked rows sink to an inset well on hover.
components.navigation_pattern: Small floating glass pill: three links and an inset theme toggle.
components.inputs: Tag filters are plain mono text; the active tag is inset.

visual_language.contrast_level: low surface contrast, high text contrast
visual_language.ornamentation: none; depth appears only on interaction and on a few controls

composition.hierarchy_method: size + weight + depth (extruded = actionable, inset = data)

imagery.photography: single portrait in an inset frame

examples: Applied AI engineer. Data Scientist at Tech Observer.

overview.fallback_strategy: no animation beyond 220ms transitions; prefers-reduced-motion disables them

visual_effects.composite_notes: Neumorphism is reserved for the avatar, buttons, theme toggle and hover states, so the page reads as flat type on soft clay.
